column1: # tools/css/gen-condition-tables.py: what the pinned webref omits about the conditional and descriptor at-rules. Tab separated, the section first:
#  media-type      NAME  CLASS  NOTE     CLASS is live (matches by the environment's medium: all print screen) or deprecated (valid, matches nothing)
#  media-reserved  NAME  -      NOTE     a word the grammar of <media-type> excludes
#  container-feature  NAME  ROW  NOTE     a feature of a container condition: the media feature it reads, or `logical:ROW` for inline-size and block-size, which the writing mode maps

column4: Media Queries 4, 2.3: matches printers and a print preview
Media Queries 4, 2.3: matches all devices that are not matched by print
Media Queries 4, 2.3: "User agents must recognize the following media types as valid, but must make them match nothing."
Media Queries 4, 2.3 (the served text lists speech among the deprecated types; Media Queries 5 changes: "Deprecate the speech media type"): as tty
Media Queries 4, 3: "The <media-type> production does not include the keywords only, not, and, or, and layer."
as only: it would be ambiguous in the layer(...) of @import
Conditional 5, 5.2: "width", the width of the container's content box
Conditional 5, 5.2: "inline-size", the width of the content box in a horizontal writing mode and its height in a vertical one
